keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row). The page gives 340 km2; one gazetteer cell of 253 km2 around Bückeburg and Stadthagen stands for it (ratio 0.74). The page names Bückeburg and Stadthagen only.

region.text: Bückeburg and Stadthagen, the principality's two towns (340 km2)

ledger.note: 1647: the County of Schaumburg-Lippe is formed. 'Schaumburg-Lippe was formed as a county in 1647 through the division of the County of Schaumburg', after the 1640 death of Count Otto V (the page dates the partition itself to 1647).

1807: the county becomes a principality. 'Schaumburg-Lippe was a county until 1807, when it became a principality' (infobox 'Raised to principality: 1807'); it is a 'State of the Confederation of the Rhine (1806-1813)', of the German Confederation (1815-1866), the North German Confederation (1867-1871) and the German Empire (1871-1918).
1918: the principality becomes the Free State of Schaumburg-Lippe in the German Revolution (the page gives the year, not the day).

region.text: Bückeburg and Stadthagen, the principality's two towns (340 km2)

ledger.note: 1946: Schaumburg-Lippe is merged into Lower Saxony (infobox 'Merged into Lower Saxony: 1946').

certainty.note: A fixed small territory of 340 km2 (two towns) whose frontier the page does not describe; the dossier treats it as sharp because it is a stable administrative state of the Holy Roman Empire, German Confederation and German Empire.

notes: New dossier, a state Cliopatria lacks. One state 1647-1946 under one slug: the eu-09 dossier county-of-schaumburg names 'county-of-schaumburg-lippe' as successor, so that slug is used, while eu-20-h asked for 'principality-of-schaumburg-lippe' (the same state's 1807-1918 name): link both to this dossier. Only one page opened; it gives no frontier, no ruler list and no month. 'Lower Saxony' is a name, not a project slug. The page gives no day for 1807 (principality) or for 1918 (Free State), so no month is recorded. The 253 km2 cell is coarser than the 340 km2 infobox area (the gazetteer cell size is about 250 km2).
